mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL value exceeding 245.0 indicates elevated inflation, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high retail sales (RSAFS > 470,000 million) indicates a tight labor market and strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) signals economic overheating and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST > 1090.0) indicates robust consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1090.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 104.0) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 104.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST > 1100.0) and retail sales (RSAFS > 475000) indicates strong consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), a slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO growth < 0.2% month-over-month) signals manufacturing weakness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and INDPRO growth < 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
